description: This file defines extension methods for the XGraphics class in the PdfSharp library, adding PDF/UA accessibility features such as drawing strings with structural tags, abbreviations, images with alt text, links, and list items, integrating with a structure builder and UA manager.

classes.name: XGraphicsExtensions
classes.description: A static class providing extension methods for XGraphics to support PDF/UA accessibility features.

methods.name: DrawString
methods.description: Draws a string with a structural tag (block or inline level) for PDF/UA accessibility, beginning and ending structure elements.

methods.name: DrawAbbreviation
methods.description: Draws an abbreviation with expanded text, wrapped in a span element for accessibility.

methods.name: DrawImage
methods.description: Draws an image with alternative text and optional bounding box for accessibility.

methods.name: DrawLink
methods.description: Draws a hyperlink with accessibility annotation and optional alt text.

methods.name: DrawListItem
methods.description: Draws a list item with structure tags for accessibility, including label and list body.
